---
title: Departmental publications
pagetitle: "Publications"
---


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse,quietly=TRUE)

extract_stats_authors = function(x) {
  x |>
    str_split("(?<=\\));\\s*(?=(?:Prof|Dr|Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss)\\s)") |>
    map(str_trim) |>
    map(\(authors) keep(authors, \(a) str_detect(a, "Statistical Science"))) |>
    map(\(authors) str_extract(authors, "^[^(]+") |> str_trim()) |>
    map_chr(\(a) paste(a, collapse = "; "))
}

data=readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("assets","Stats-publications.xlsx")) |>
  select(
    c(
      `Publication Type`,`Online Publication Date`,`Title`,`Journal`,
      `Article On Publisher's Website`,`All UCL Authors`
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    stats_authors = extract_stats_authors(`All UCL Authors`),
    Year=lubridate::year(`Online Publication Date`),
    Title=case_when(
      !is.na(`Article On Publisher's Website`)~paste0(
        "[",str_to_title(Title),"](",`Article On Publisher's Website`,")"
      ),
      TRUE~str_to_title(Title)
    ),
    `Online Publication Date`=paste0(
      "Publication date: ",`Online Publication Date`
    ),
    Journal=case_when(
      is.na(Journal)~"",
      TRUE~Journal
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    c(
      Title,Journal,`Online Publication Date`,stats_authors,
      `Publication Type`,Year
    )
  )

pubs=data |>
  mutate(
    Title = str_replace(Title, "\\[(.*?)\\]\\((.*?)\\)", '<a href="\\2" target="_blank">\\1</a>'),
    `Online Publication Date` = as.character(`Online Publication Date`),
    `Publication Type` = as.factor(`Publication Type`),
    Year = as.factor(Year)
  ) |>
  select(Title, Journal, stats_authors, `Publication Type`, Year) |>
  arrange(desc(Year)) |>
  DT::datatable(
    class = list(stripe = FALSE),
    escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = c("RowGroup", "Select", "SearchPanes"),
    selection = "none",
    colnames = rep("", 5),
    options = list(
      info = FALSE,
      paging = FALSE,
      dom = "Pfrtip",
      search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
      searchPanes = list(initCollapsed = TRUE),
      language = list(lengthMenu = "_MENU_"),
      rowGroup = list(dataSrc = 4),     # group by Year
      pageLength = 200,
      columnDefs = list(
        list(visible = FALSE, targets = c(3, 4)),               # hide Publication Type and Year
        list(searchPanes = list(show = FALSE), targets = 0),    # no pane for Title
        list(searchPanes = list(show = FALSE), targets = c(1,2)), # no pane for date/authors
        list(searchPanes = list(show = TRUE, header = "Select Year"), targets = 4),
        list(searchPanes = list(show = TRUE, header = "Select type"), targets = 3)
      ),
      order = list(list(3, "desc"))    # sort by Year so grouping displays cleanly
    )
  )
pubs
```
